tei:div.tei:p: "$ (153) ༄༅// kyai rdo rje'i gtor chog mdzes rgyan bzhugs so/// /

(154)༄༅// na maḥshri tsa kra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos yi dam chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ gnas khang bla re dang yol ba la sogs pas brgyan/ chos skyong gi bris sku yod na zhal shar ram lhor phyogs par dgram/ de'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa ras la sogs pas bkab pa'i steng du 'bru sna tshogs gcal du bkram/ de'i steng du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam lnga la sogs pa pad+ma'i dbyibs can bsad sha ma yin pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod la sogs pa gtsang zhing bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu dang nang mchod la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnam kyang ma tshang ba med par bshams la/ lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du (155)ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du shar du go las ba lang gi sha /lhor ku las khyi'i sha /nub tu da las rta'i sha /byang du ha las glang po che'i sha /dbus su na las mi'i sha /sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang*/ shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor ām̐ las rak+ta// nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du kham̐ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/

lhor ām̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ āḥ g.yas skor gyis ka kha ga gha nga*/ (156)tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas la/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams skol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag /yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje ljid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes gsum mam lnga brjod de byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po// lhor lha'i dbang po// nub tu tshangs pa/

byang du khyab 'jug /shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po// lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po// nub byang du bhṛṅgi ri ti/ byang shar du gzhon nu kārti ka te thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la (157)'khyud pa/ bar gyis chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar dbus su hūm̐ las dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhes pa nas gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ de'i pang du aṃ las yum rdo rje bdag med ma nag mo zhes sogs nas dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar du gaṃ las gau ri nag mo zhes sogs zhal phyag gsal btab/ de bzhin du lhor tsam̐ las tsau rī sogs/ nub tu bam̐ las be tā lī sogs/ byang du gham̐ las ghasma rī sogs/ byang shar du pam̐ las puk+ka si sogs/ shar lhor shaṃ las ri khrod ma sogs/ lho nub tu laṃ las gdol pa mo sogs/ nub byang du ḍam̐ las g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs zhes sogs nas dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha// lho nub tu srin po// nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong*/ nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po// lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di dag thams cad pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa steng na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs (158)skyong brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kye rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs nas/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ slar yang snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs nas/ 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang*/ zhes sogs nas/ ḍoṃ bi nī la 'od dpag med// phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa// gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi he badz+ra sa pā ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi ti hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba sa sho bha ni swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kham̐ ram̐ ma hā ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu bzhi phul/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing*/

pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje thal mo kha (159) gyen du phye la/ oṃ bha ga wā ra sogs nas/ sa pa ri wā ra in+da/ dza ma dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhū ta/ bah+ni/ bā u/ rak+kha/ tsan+da/ sudz+dza ma da/ baspa/ ta la/ pā tā le/ āṭ+ṭa sap+sa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ dzigha/ phul+la/ dhūp+pa/ māṃ sa/ piṃ gha/ ām+bha/ sap+pa/ gadz+dza/ sā da/ khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa gā da/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ.ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod cing se gol brdab/ de lta bu gsum mam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma phul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kye rdo rje lha dgu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes dang*/ mthe bo'i thor mas nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang*/ dril bu sum brdung bya zhing*/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs nas yid kyis dgyes/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po (160)rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod//

zhes pas bstod/ rdo rje thugs kar bzung*/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams= sha za'i tshogs= smyo byed= brjed byed= mkha' 'gro'i= ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma gzhan rnams kyi byin rlabs sngar dus gcig la grub zin yang*/ byin rlabs dran pa'i phyir gtor ma lag pa g.yon pa bstan te oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas (161) pa bstan te āḥ zhes brjod pas thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ 'di yan gyi tshig kha skong dgos pa rnams mngon rtogs dang*/

phyag rgya rnams dbang chu mdzes rgyan du blta'o// de nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍi bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhal gyi mche ba gtsigs pa// dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub gyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag /g.yon na khyi nag /rgyab na lce spyang*/ mdun na mi nag /steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭam̐ las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ (162)ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu ga pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung thung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/

ru pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgogs pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ// mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ thal ma khang stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam rgya bcas te/ mdzub mo'i g.yab pa'am/ rdo rjes g.yab cing dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol la/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa srung ba (163)dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la e h+ye hi

zhes dang*/ sor mo phan tshun cung zad bsnol ba'i rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba lha mo'i dam rgya g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha mo kun gshegs sogs nas/ gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wā e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hā+oḥ so so la thim/ thal mo sbyar ba'i sor mo dbus ma gsum so sor bskyed de/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas pad+ma'i gdan phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gṛh+ne daṃ ma hā kā lī de wī gṛh+ne daṃ ār+ghaṃ swā ha/ pā d+ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da ā hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ mgon po'i dam rgya snying gar bcas te de'i spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa ma ya smar/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ lha mo'i dam rgya snying gar bcas te de'i spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī sa ma ya smar zhes sogs kyis dam la bzhag /spro na/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang*/ bdag gis lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/(164)gang la gang 'tsham pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzer ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bsdigs shing spa bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub cing bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang 'jig rten pa kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing thal mo brdab/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā sa pa ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ āt+ga te/ s+phar ṇa i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇedaṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes gsum mam/ lnga dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra ti dz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ kha khā khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam lngas mgon po dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lī de wī sa pā ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te zhes sogs gsum mam lngas lha mo la phul te/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ zhes sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis gong ltar mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba dhod sā kā ma la rak+kha si hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo dang*/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ hūm̐ gi ye shes las byung ba'i// nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa// zhal gcig mdog (165)sngon cher 'bar zhing*// zangs gri thod pa bsnams la bstod// mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas// mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung*// bong thung gzi brjid chen po ste// zhal dmar rnam par g.yo la bstod// slob dpon la rtag sdang ba dang*// gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la gnod// sems can sna tshogs gcod pa rnams// za byed nag mo che la bstod// bh+yoḥ

rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod// mtsho rnams skems par nus ma ste// bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir// lha chen sku yi phyed du bzhag /rdzong dang bka' zlog nag mo ste// lha dang lha min phyag byas pa// mi nad gang yin khyod ming shes// de la 'jigs pa med par mdzad// gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi yum// 'dod khams dbang phyug ma la bstod// ces pas bstod/ rdo rje snying gar bzung ste/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i// rgya chen mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing*// bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe legs brtan nas// rnam dkar phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol// khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang blo gros bsod nams rab rgyas nas// thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// bdag gi 'dod pa'i phrin las zhu ba ni// 'chi bdag bdud kyi bar chad kun zhi zhing*// rdo rje theg (166)pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i// bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces brjod de nas gdong bzhi pa'i gtor ma mgon po'i skabs ltar byin rlabs dran par byas la/ mdun du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po// g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag /phyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang*/ g.yon 'og mas rus phreng 'phyar thabs su mdzad pa/

skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ma mchu 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan zhing zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa// drag la rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ ngag tu ha ha dang*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ dang*/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo// g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo// rgyab tu siṃgha lī ma ser nag /bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu rgyan med pa rab tu grims shing khros pa'i cha lugs can/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor lnga ka'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas ti se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod nas nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ thal mo sbyar ba'i srin lag nang du bkug la mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab (167) nas rwa ltar byas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo g.yab pa'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin// phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā/ bi kā la/ rā tṛ ta/ ḍoṃ bi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+kha sī/ sīṃgha lī/ de wī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas bstim/ sngar ltar/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā sogs nas/ de wī sa pa ri wā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ ār+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas te de'i spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/

oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā sogs nas de wī sa ma ya sma ra sogs kyis dam la bzhag /spro na/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs kyis bka' bsgos la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā sogs nas/ de wī na maḥsarba ta thā ga te zhes sogs btags pa gsum mam lnga dang*/ spro na 'og gi sngags ring gis kyang phul/ gong ltar mchod la nang mchod phul te/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā sogs nas/ de wī 'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes sogs gong ltar brjod la/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ hūm̐ mi rtog dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig /'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas// bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can// rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings las bzhengs// dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs shing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba// sgra sgrogs dril bu'i phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ (168)gdong bzhi ldan khyod ti se'i zhing skyong mdzad// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhis pa'i// nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa// yum chen srin mo bzhi dang bcas// sha chen zan dang me tog spos// chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas las mgon gyi gtor ma byin brlabs sngar ltar dran par byas la/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang*// lha mo'i thugs ka nas m+mam̐ mdun du spros pas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing gser gyi rna cha can/

de'i m+mam̐ las nag mo gnod sbyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri/ g.yon klad khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' gyon zhing byi ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang yum las bh+yoḥgacig mdun du spros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ tri las pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi ang rag dang*/ dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ tri las bha ṭa nag po stag slag can/ g.yas dam shing dang*/ g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas srin mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i phreng ba dang mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ rngam zhing 'khrugs pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ (169)gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba sngags pa nag po brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag mi nag ce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las kyi mgon po rnams la bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas thim par bsam/ mgon po'i skabs kyi dam rgya bcas te de rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ a li a li ma/ dza dza/ sham̐ sham̐/ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo smugs/ pu trī/ a li ma/ dza dza/ nag mo sha la ru ba/ dza dza/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa ya la/ a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥs ma ya sma ra sogs kyis dam la bzhag

/spro na/ las kyi mgon po bka' sdod pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sogs kyis bka' bsgos la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye sta ེ/ a li a li ma sogs nas/ ma hūm̐ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ*/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas gtor ma phul la/ oṃ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ nang mchod phul te/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring*/ sprul pa'i ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes sogs gong ltar brjod la/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ hūm̐ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs// rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyis// bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa// bstan srung yab yum che la (170)bstod// mon bu pu tra nag po skyong*// mon gyi ga sha sku la gsol// sheng shing gseg shang phyag na bsnams// pu tra nag po khyod la bstod// mon bu bha ṭa stag slag bkra// dar gyi ga sha sku la gsol// phyag na dom shing rnon po bsnams// mon bu bha ṭa khyod la bstod// mon mo gser gyi spu gri ma// nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma// phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams// nag mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul// bud med nag mo chen mo brgya// gshegs kyi de ni shul yang 'dren// g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa// skyes bu stag chas brgyan pa brgya// g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa// dge slong nyan thos dgra bcom brgya// slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba// ban+de nag po phur thogs brgya// 'khor 'das kun la bstod pa 'bul// skabs gsum dag kyang bstod pa 'bul// zhes pas bstod/ rdo rje snying gar gzung ste/ las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang gsang ba zhes sogs sngar ltar sbyar la phrin las gzhol/

mkha' 'gro spyi gtor byin rlabs dran pa gong ltar byas la/ lag pa'i 'dzum mo gnyis lu gu rgyud du sprel/ mthe bong gnyis dang gung mo gnyis so sor sbyar/ sor mo lhag ma rnams 'bar ba ltar rgyas pa dpral ba'i steng du g.yon du bskor/ gdong bsgyur zhing mig gyen du blta ba dang bcas pas/ phaiṃ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ/ ba dz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ/ zhes brjod de snying ga'i hūm̐ gis 'od zer gyis 'dzam bu'i gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsams te/ thal ma kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ un+mā da/ a pa smar/ ḍā ka /ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i ma ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa na/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ (171)ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭam̐/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ bi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta yā/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wan+tu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo zhes sogs gong ltar brjod la/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus zhes sogs nas/ ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas kyis// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces brjod/ ༈ bzlas pa byed na/ yungs dkar/ gu gul/ dug /tshil chen rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos bsreg cing*/ de wa pi tsu phreng skor gcig bzlas la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi (172 )thugs kar phog pas/ thugs rgyud bskul te gang bsgo ba nyan par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yi ge bdun pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bcu gnyis pa dang*/ shā sa na rnams ci nus bzla/ sngags gsum po go rim spyi dang mthun par bzlas kyang rung ngo*// de nas lha mo la dmigs pa gtad la ro ru sogs dang*/

spro na/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes pa bzla/ de bzhin du zhal bzhi pa la dmigs la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla/ rjes su/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kaṭ+ṭa ka rā la/ lam+bi ta o ṭha/ lam+ba ka be ka /lam+ba ka pā le/ ra wi ghaṇ+ḍe/ ru tra mā la bi hu re/ ts+tshe da ha ka le/ ha le na ha le pim+bi dzā li/ bā me ghun+di dha ri yaṃ ma aṃ/ da hi na karti ka kā ro ṭi/ bi bhi ṣa ṇa dha aṃ/ bā mi/ 'di nas mi mdzad/ mchan/ la pā ṇi/ ha ra do ra na ra sī ra mā la/ sa ta le k+ṣiṃ/ kā ra ka la/ ma hā po ṭa le/ ma hā kā la/ shrī ka bī la/ ke la saṃ k+ṣe ṭa pa la/ hā hā kā re hūm̐ hūm̐ kā re/ surba bhā ṣa bhi uṃ/ dzau dzan+ti mi sa bha ta/ phul+la dhū pa/ i kā ha ba li dzi gha ha/ da sha di ka urta ra wu ri/ ḍom bhi nī tsaṇ+ḍa lī rak+kha sī siṃ gha lī de wī/ ha na ha na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ma ra ma ra/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ/ la hi ba liṃ de hi sid+dhi/ bi kā la sha trū na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ de nas las mgon rnams la dmigs pa gtad la/ 'jig rten pa rnams mos pho bskul ba yin pas thog mar/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la zhes sogs mo'i bod pa cha gnyis su bzla/ de nas a li a li ma zhes sogs pho'i bod pa cha gcig tu bzla/ bzlas pa rdzogs pa na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya daṃ ār+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bul zhing sngags rnams kyi mthar/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang/ mthu stobs kyis dbang phyug nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi (173)zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes sogs sngar bzhin brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bstod pa gsar rnying gang rung sha lo ka res bstod la/ rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ dril bu lding khugs su dkrol te/

rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya/ gtor ma skyong na 'das gtor bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du bzhag /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar dang bcas nas khyer te 'og nas 'byung ba ltar spyi bstabs byas la/ nang du log nas lhag chad kha bskangs ba sogs rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// gal te de dang 'brel bar bskang bshags la sogs pa byed na bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod pa yan tshad rdzogs par byas nas rten la kha phyogs par langs te/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshig gang rigs sngon du 'gro bas me tog dang bcas te bshags pa'i tshig rnams lan gsum brjod/ bskang gso dang 'brel na gur mgon gyi bskang gso skabs 'dir bya zhing*/ gdong bzhi pa'i bskang gso ni phyag len la gtor 'bul dang 'brel bar gong du mdzad la 'dir byed par spro na spyan 'dren gyi tshig rnams gong du byas nas/ bskang gtor byin rlabs/ 'bul ba/ bskang gso dngos gzhi rnams 'dir byas kyang nyes pa med do// bstod pa la dbyangs byed na gong du mchod gtor 'bul ba tsam las bstod pa dang bstabs pa'i tshig rnams mi bya bar/ skabs 'dir mgon po lcam dral dang gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa dang bstabs pa rnams rim pas byas la/ de'i rjes su srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan mdzod// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// ces thun mong du phrin las bcol/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// zhes sogs dang rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam bcas bya/

de nas las mgon gyi bstod bskul byas (174) la/ gnas khang de nyid dam/ khang thog la sogs pa'i phyogs gtsang mar spos kyis sna drangs te/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma rnams mtha' nas rim pas btegs la rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang*// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i// dur khrod bdag po zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas// snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud 'khor dang bcas// mkha' lding bya khyi lcags spyang 'khor dang bcas// pu tra la sogs las mkhan 'khor dang bcas// srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dzam+bu ti ka'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig /chang dang phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan po 'bul// da bcol las kyi gsal 'debs gnyan po bzhes// 'khor rnams srung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po// thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur tu sgrubs// zhes brjod la shā sa na bzla zhing gtor ma sa gtsang sar btang*/ mgron rnams gtor mas tshim ste dges bzhin du rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ nang du 'ongs te yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces brjod/ rten yod na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa (175)la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rten la me tog gtor/ rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyis se gol byas la/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ// rang gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhes sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas bsrung ba byas la/ dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo zhing chos mthun gyi spyod pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// 'di ni gtor bsngo tsam dang 'brel bar bskang bshags la sogs pa bya ba'i tshul yin la/ gtor ma la brten nas las bsgrub pa la gtor sgrub ces grags pa'i cho ga'i rim pa ni gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal dang*/ de'i lhan thabs g.yul las rnam rgyal nas 'byung ba'i don/ man ngag dang phyag len gyis brgyan shes par bya dgos kyi/ dbyangs dang rnga brdung mi byed pa la gtor bsngo dang*/ de rnams byed pa la gtor sgrub tu 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i log rtog rnams rgyang ring du dor la/ legs par bslabs te brda' dang tha snyad tsam la yang mkhas par byas nas bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog tu ci 'gyur gyi thabs la 'bad dgos so zhes lag len pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// de ltar yi dam chos skyong gi /gtor ma'i cho ga mdzes rgyan 'di// (176)bka' drin mnyam med 'khor lo'i mgon// rat+na war+dha yab sras kyi// zhabs kyi rdul phran la reg pa'i// btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis// blo dman 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir// e waṃ chos ldan dgon par sbyar// sngags rnams phal cher rgya dpe la// gtugs te dag par bgyid pas na// ring thung gcod mtshams la sogs pa// 'di nyid kho na dang du long*// 'di la nongs gang sgo gsum gyi// sdig dang lhan cig mgon la bshags// legs pa'i dge des bdag gzhan kun// bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal gyur cig
